description: Before the freeze the target's pin is re-pointed at a new weaker abbrev; the freeze is refused (markup, no gate attempt used); the script restores the pin, freezes and proves honestly.

questions.question: Does "cannot have" state a rule about what PG games should not include (normative), or that a PG game is unable to contain such a character (literal)?

options.label: A rule (normative)
options.consequence: A PG game with such a character breaks the rule; it says nothing about what the game contains.

options.label: Impossible (literal)
options.consequence: No PG game contains a character with a dark past at all.

steps.newString:
stance: rule
asserted: 2026-11-01
-/
/-- PG games cannot have characters with dark pasts -/
abbrev pg_no_dark_past : Prop := ∀ (g : Game) (c : Character), IsPG g → HasDarkPast c → ¬ GoodAddition c g
axiom pg_no_dark_past.holds : pg_no_dark_past
